mentions.name: Bloomberry
mentions.description: A tool that helps GTM teams find companies that have started using over 1,600 enterprise technology products, such as HubSpot or Workday. It is positioned as an alternative to BuiltWith but focused much more on non-frontend tools.
mentions.problem: Existing tools like BuiltWith focus mainly on frontend technologies, making it hard to find companies adopting non-frontend enterprise tools.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Bloomberry to help GTM teams find companies that started using over 1600 enterprise technology products (ie Hubspot or Workday) it’s an alternative to tools like Builtwith but focused much more on non-frontend tools
mentions.author: AznHisoka

mentions.name: Bloomberry
mentions.description: This tool detects when companies subscribe to or churn from over 1600 B2B tech products and surfaces those changes as sales signals, serving as an alternative to BuiltWith/Wappalyzer. Unlike those tools, it focuses on backend/backoffice products such as HubSpot CRM, NetSuite, or Microsoft 365 rather than frontend technologies like WordPress or React.
mentions.problem: Existing tech-detection tools like BuiltWith and Wappalyzer only cover frontend technologies, leaving no visibility into which companies adopt or drop backend/backoffice B2B software.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Bloomberry (https://bloomberry.com), an alternative to tools like BuiltWith/Wappalyzer to provide sales signals when companies subscribe or churn from over 1600 B2B tech products. Think backend/backoffice tools like Hubspot CRM, or Netsuite, or Microsoft 365, rather than frontend technologies like Wordpress or React.
mentions.author: AznHisoka
